scientific_integrity: Riccati and schedule formulas independently derived; analytical inequalities prove all parameters; representative exact rational computations are supplementary; no independent audit or scientific uniqueness certification.
scientific_limitations: Unbounded multiplicative ratio applies to schedule-dependent, nonnegative excess LQG cost, not the full LQG objective with an additive schedule-independent constant; scalar stable plants, two steps, zero process noise, lossless packets.
title: Unbounded scheduling-excess ratio for a two-agent LQG transmission auction
